responsibility: Provides RVV-specific post-gimplification and combine-oriented optimization patterns that refine auto-vectorized RTL into cheaper RISC-V vector instructions. It mainly defines split and combine rules for mask simplification, predicated unary/binary forms, early-break vector idioms, and specialized fusions such as widening shifts or vandn so that generic autovectorizer output from autovec.md and middle-end combines can be re-expressed as efficient predicated RVV instructions with the right VL/VLMAX expansion helpers.
